candidates.quote: You may try the same action, on your own judgement, and report the result, allowed or refused, as a data point.
candidates.reader_rule: rules/safety.md: "Never run anything destructive without my explicit go-ahead in this conversation: deleting files outside the working tree, `rm -rf`, dropping tables, force-pushing, rewriting published history." The unlimited permission to repeat a refused action has no limit for destructive actions.

candidates.quote: The reviewer may try an action you reported as refused, on its own judgement, and report what happened.
candidates.reader_rule: rules/safety.md: "Never run anything destructive without my explicit go-ahead in this conversation". The permission to retry a refused action on the reviewer's own judgement is unlimited, so it covers destructive actions too.
